answer: Require every identity to lock a refundable bond in a shared vault before its answer counts, and slash that bond when a jury catches copied or incoherent work. A real agent pays once and earns it back over time, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, so flooding the network gets expensive fast. The bond is verified against the nectar, ivory and willow attestations before any reward settles, so one operator cannot clone identities for free.
